title: Publish the digest-pinned Vault release signer toolchain image
expected_outcome: The Vault signer image is published to the repository GHCR namespace only when its Dockerfile input hash differs from the current main image; its resulting immutable digest is recorded as rollout evidence.
constraints: Do not apply Terraform, access AWS, Vault, or EKS, alter secrets, or enable the CodeBuild signer.
Use only the repository-owned GitHub Actions workflow and GHCR package namespace.

external_actions: push committed workflow configuration to origin/main
dispatch repository-owned Toolchain Image Release workflow

primary_owner.responsibility: supply-chain integration, authorization boundary, and final sign-off
